Customs

جدول التعريفة الجمركية

An official list of duties, taxes, or tariffs levied by a country on imported or exported goods, arranged by commodity code and rate, as published and maintained by customs authorities or under trade agreements.

Quick answer: An official list of duties, taxes, or tariffs levied by a country on imported or exported goods, arranged by commodity code and rate, as published and maintained by customs authorities or under trade agreements.

Why it matters

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An official list of duties, taxes, or tariffs levied by a country on imported or exported goods, arranged by commodity code and rate, as published and maintained by customs authorities or under trade agreements.

Operational example

According to the customs tariff schedule, different duty rates apply based on the specific HS code of the imported goods.
